product_metadata.title: Vollrath Economy Mixing Bowl Set (1-1/2, 3 & 5-Quart, Stainless Steel)
features: COOKS ILLUSTRATED TOP RATED: Rated in the test kitchen for mixing performance, ease of use and a durability test based on washing, bumping, dropping and double boiling.
SET OF 3 ESSENTIAL SIZES: Have the perfect sizes kitchen tools handy every time in this value pack assortment. These 1-1/2, 3 and 5-quart bowls are ideal for whisking, mixing, marinating and serving.

PREMIUM QUALITY STAINLESS STEEL: These lightweight commercial grade stainless steel mixing bowls can double as serving bowls. These strong and sturdy metal bowls won’t stain, absorb odors or rust, giving you years of durability.
SPACE SAVING DESIGN: The stackable design is ideal for space saving, and a simple solution that de-clutters your kitchen.

REFRIGERATOR, FREEZER & DISHWASHER SAFE: Meal prep couldn't be easier. No more soaking. Dishwasher safe stainless steel mixing bowl set free from harmless chemical and bacterial. Simply wipe clean refrigerate, freeze and store, you’ll love the versatility.
